WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_artifacts) as grand_total
  FROM site_totals
),
site_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.zoneref,
    st.total_artifacts,
    CAST(st.total_artifacts AS REAL) / ot.grand_total as share
  FROM site_totals st
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
  WHERE ot.grand_total IS NOT NULL
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM site_shares
)
SELECT 
  ss.zoneref,
  ss.total_artifacts,
  ss.share,
  ss.share - avg.avg_share as difference
FROM site_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_share avg
WHERE avg.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Sites with all NULL articount values are excluded from the analysis. The filter WHERE articount IS NOT NULL in site_totals ensures only sites with at least one non-NULL articount contribute to the overall total. The phrase 'ignoring missing counts' is interpreted as including only sites with non-NULL articount data.

alternatives.interpretation: Include sites with all NULL articount values in the output, with NULL share and NULL difference (appearing at the end after sorting in DESC order). This represents sites present in scanfeatures but with no actual artifact counts recorded.
alternatives.sql:
WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_artifacts) as grand_total
  FROM site_totals
),
site_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.zoneref,
    st.total_artifacts,
    CASE WHEN st.total_artifacts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(st.total_artifacts AS REAL) / ot.grand_total END as share
  FROM site_totals st
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
  WHERE ot.grand_total IS NOT NULL
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM site_shares
)
SELECT 
  ss.zoneref,
  ss.total_artifacts,
  ss.share,
  ss.share - avg.avg_share as difference
FROM site_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_share avg
WHERE avg.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
